query: Hey, a customer emailed saying they tried to check out a big bulk order this morning and just got "something went wrong, please try again" over and over. They said it happened three times in a row with the same cart. Can someone look into whether checkout is down?

Saw this in the checkout-service logs: AssertionError: CheckoutError: computed cart total is negative (-4032 cents) for 160 items — refusing to charge a corrupted amount. Only showing up for a handful of requests today, all with unusually large carts. Not sure yet if it's a code bug or something upstream feeding bad data.

We're getting reports that order-confirmation emails aren't going out. A customer placed an order an hour ago and says they never got the confirmation, and I can't find any error in our own dashboards - just silence. Might be an email provider outage on their end.

notifications-service just threw notifications.templates.UnknownTemplateError: no such template: order_shipped when we tried to send a shipment update for order #88213. Looks like the dispatcher is being called with a template name that doesn't exist in templates.py.

A few users are reporting they get logged out randomly mid-session, sometimes within a couple minutes of logging in. Could be our token TTL, could be clock drift between app servers, could be something in how we're issuing tokens - I honestly can't tell which side of the fence this is on.
A customer says they never got the SMS reminder about their password reset, but did get it by email a minute later. Is that a bug in how we pick channels, or is it just their carrier being slow?

A user says their account got temporarily locked after only 3 failed login attempts, but the docs say the limit is 5. Is that a real off-by-one in our rate limiter, or maybe they mistyped their password a couple extra times without noticing?

Getting intermittent 'invalid credentials' errors for users we've confirmed are typing the right password. It comes and goes, no pattern by user. Wondering if this is actually an auth-service bug or something flaky in front of it, like a load balancer routing to a stale instance.

One of our users reset their password yesterday and now can't log in with the new one at all - always says invalid credentials, every single time, no exceptions. Looks pretty deterministic, not flaky.

Customer says her cart total looked wrong at checkout - way higher than it should have been for what she ordered. Could be a pricing/discount bug, could just be her not accounting for tax, we're not sure which yet.

Support is seeing a cluster of tickets: users report being logged out unexpectedly AND, separately, some of those same users say their password reset emails never arrived. Not sure if these two things are related or two different bugs in auth-service.

Grepped through our auth-service error logs from last night and found nothing but successful logins and expected LoginError('invalid credentials')/LoginError('unknown user') entries - no stack traces, no 500s. A user is still insisting login is broken for them specifically though. Can you dig into whether there's an actual code bug here?

Two users on the same corporate VPN both say login just spins forever and times out, no error message at all. Everyone else is fine. Not sure if that's an auth-service bug or their VPN/network doing something weird.

Logs show a spike of LoginError: invalid credentials right after our last deploy, plus a separate report that the rate limiter locked out a user way faster than it should have. Both started around the same time - might be one root cause or might be a coincidence of two things breaking at once.

Push notifications have completely stopped going out company-wide as of about 20 minutes ago - dashboard shows zero deliveries in that window across every channel. Feels like a downstream outage with our push provider rather than anything in our code.

Big enterprise customer (500+ item cart, they do bulk restocking orders) says checkout keeps failing for them specifically, every time, but works fine for their smaller test orders. Getting a generic 500 back, no details in the response body.

We're seeing two things together on large bulk-order carts: (1) the checkout call sometimes 500s, and (2) even when it doesn't, the receipt shown to the customer has a total that doesn't match what we actually charged their card. Might be the same bug or two separate ones in checkout-service.

Customer says they added 3 items to their cart, went to check out, and the page just hung for over a minute before finally timing out - no error, just a spinner forever. Wondering if the checkout service is overloaded or stuck on something.

A user reports that after their account got rate-limited from too many login attempts, they waited the full cooldown window and tried again with the correct password, but it still says invalid credentials even now. Genuinely unsure if that's the rate limiter, the password check, or the user still mistyping.

One report says a user's session token expired way earlier than the 1-hour TTL should allow, and a second, unrelated-seeming report says another user got a 'rate limited' error despite only trying to log in twice. Both came in within the same 10 minutes - might be connected, might not.
